source.caption: Figure 1 ( a ) GPCs of Pt /uniFB01 lms according to the exposure time of the precursor and counter reactants during the ALD process. HDMP and O2 gas were used as the precursor and counter reactant, respectively, for the ALD of Pt. ( b ) Apparent coverage of the Pt /uniFB01 lms deposited by ALD using the MeCpPtMe3 (blue) and HDMP (red) precursors. The solid lines indicate the corresponding /uniFB01 tting results for the nucleation model. ( c -f ) Typical SEM images showing the Pt deposited via ALD using the MeCpPtMe3 precursor ( c , d ) and the HDMP precursor ( e , f ) at 100 and 200 cycles. ( g ) Density functional theory-calculated energies of the critical points along the reaction coordinate for the adsorption of the two precursors. ( h ) Electrical resistivity of the Pt /uniFB01 lms deposited by ALD according to the number of ALD cycles.

assumptions: the /cycle dimension is preserved; Å/cycle never degrades to nm
